statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a recent transient ischemic attack
The service was to capture intermittent arrhythmias and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The service was to guide anticoagulation and rate control management
The diagnoses addressed are I48.91, G45.9, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to service delivery
